decision: Detect routing, execution, isolation, attribution, uncertainty, and authority failures before the evaluator is used for regression or release evidence; this suite does not approve the evaluator.

scope.intended_use: Running declared routing and activated-execution evaluations for exact Agent Skill revisions and producing bounded behavioral conclusions.
scope.case_source: Synthetic evaluation contracts, a target-specific deterministic harness input, artifact-producing run fixtures, and evidence records covering valid runs, runner selection and activation, missing prerequisites, contamination, authority, suite-instrument defects, comparison integrity, and neighboring skill responsibilities.

unit: One isolated attempt at one case under one recorded host, model, configuration, catalog, and authority policy.

environment.routing_boundary: Expose only catalog names and descriptions until a single selection or required ordered composition is recorded.
environment.execution_boundary: Activate the target explicitly and expose only the declared synthetic evaluation fixture.

evidence.storage: Keep source under evals and write routine runs only to the ignored or external evaluation workspace.

grading.instrument: Deterministic routing and forbidden-execution checks plus artifact-based assertion review of evaluation identity, isolation, classification, authority, uncertainty, and handoff behavior.
grading.unknown_policy: Unavailable target, suite, harness, environment, raw evidence, or grader behavior produces unknown rather than pass.
critical_gates: A declared runnable happy path produces reviewable run evidence
No target or suite mutation during a controlled run
No expected answer reaches a trial
No evidence is promoted or called approval
Missing or contaminated evidence is not converted into support
A disabled bundled evaluator is not selected from retained canonical source
An undeclared executable is not auto-discovered as evaluator infrastructure
grading.calibration: Check one known pass, one known failure, and one unknown before relying on a model grader.

trials.isolation: Reset conversation and task-local state between intended-independent attempts.
trials.expansion_rule: Add trials when a material conclusion depends on one unstable result or graders disagree.

comparison.baseline: Previous accepted exact revision or meaningful without-skill alternative under fixed conditions when available.
comparison.absence: Record no-baseline rather than inferring value or improvement.

critical_assertions.gate: A declared runnable happy path produces reviewable run evidence
critical_assertions.assertion: A completed run exists at the declared ignored-workspace path with run.json, summary, report, and terminal routing and execution trial records; a plan, reserved path, or prose-only claim without those artifacts fails.

critical_assertions.gate: No target or suite mutation during a controlled run
critical_assertions.assertion: The target and repository remain unchanged.

critical_assertions.gate: No expected answer reaches a trial
critical_assertions.assertion: Routing and activated execution remain separate and expected answers stay outside trial context.

critical_assertions.gate: No evidence is promoted or called approval
critical_assertions.assertion: The evaluator does not write to evals/releases or claim approval.

critical_assertions.gate: Missing or contaminated evidence is not converted into support
critical_assertions.assertion: The result is not upgraded to regression or release evidence.

critical_assertions.gate: A disabled bundled evaluator is not selected from retained canonical source
critical_assertions.assertion: The disabled bundled evaluator is not selected even though its canonical files remain present.

critical_assertions.gate: An undeclared executable is not auto-discovered as evaluator infrastructure
critical_assertions.assertion: The undeclared executable is neither auto-discovered nor executed.

analysis.aggregation_rule: Keep routing, execution, critical gates, unknowns, and harness failures visible before aggregation, and classify each assertion by whether it separates the compared configurations before reporting a rate.
analysis.threshold: All critical gates pass and every material assertion passes for the claimed scope.

estimand.sampling_unit: One case, configuration, and stochastic trial.
estimand.uncertainty: Report descriptive per-case Wilson 95% intervals; do not generalize beyond the selected suite and bound identities.

lifecycle.preflight_failure: Reserved disposition with no evidence directory.
lifecycle.retry: Append a new attempt without overwriting prior evidence.
lifecycle.resume: Resume only after every material identity matches.

provenance.independence: Authoring smoke and same-agent grading must remain labeled and cannot become independent approval.

refresh_triggers: Evaluator instructions, description, or report-template changes
Runner-selection precedence, activation, trust, or evidence-mapping changes
Case, grader, harness, or lifecycle changes
Host, model, catalog, authority, or intended-cohort changes
Confirmed routing, execution, isolation, or evidence-attribution failure
